sections.Profile:
"Super Jumbo" and "Deluxe Jumbo" are electro-mechanical pinball machines released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1954. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, these were among the first 4-player pinball machines.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1954
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Women, Good Times, Wood Rail, Circus, Original Theme, Animals
